portraits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve. Asset: square 1024 × 1024 production dialogue portrait for Neon Tides. Image 1 is Mio Amami's existing portrait and the edit target; image 2 is the game's own Nao portrait, used only for rendering quality and lighting, never face identity. Refine Mio into the same grounded, mature manga illustration quality as Nao: delicate varied ink, subtle crosshatching, painted facial planes, believable restrained adult eyes, natural asymmetry, textured practical fabric, loose individual hair strands, nuanced soft smile. Preserve Mio's identity: Japanese adult astronomer in her thirties, chestnut-brown hair in a low ponytail, green-grey eyes, thin gold oval glasses, blue observatory work coat, ivory scarf, small five-star constellation lapel pin. Keep her recognisable as the same character, keep the portrait framing and clothing, head fully in frame, shoulders and upper chest visible. Keep Tsukimi's telescope and dome suggested softly behind her with amber practical lamps, muted blue harbour night and a handful of stars. Natural warm amber side light and soft blue fill. Original fictional character; no copied manga characters, logos, lettering, smoking, chibi, exaggerated eyes, flat cartoon fill, plastic skin or photo-realistic photograph. Match Nao's fine textured illustration while preserving Mio's own distinct face. Expression: quietly welcoming, relaxed small smile, direct friendly gaze; familiar kettle-and-stars warmth.
